templates.label: Product page template
templates.help: Which layout a product page uses. T1 Classic: photos with thumbnails beside the buy column. A product's own template (chosen when it is uploaded) wins, then its category's (the nearest one up the tree), then the shop's default. With the preview on, an address ending in ?template=T2 shows that template, for checking before you switch; search engines are sent to the plain address.
